title: Endorsement Record
description: Project Rune endorsement record. Signature is Ed25519 only (structured object). independence_claimed is a claim, not proof. See decisions/PENDING-001 and PENDING-002.

endorsement_id.description: Unique identifier for this endorsement record.

reference.description: Pointer to the specific event, file, or claim being endorsed.

verifier_type.description: independent_system is schema-compatible only. The enum value alone is NOT proof of architectural independence (PENDING-002).

independence_claimed.description: Epistemic claim only — issuer asserts independence. Not enforced as proof. Replaces misleading independent_of_subject.

independence_basis.description: Optional non-authoritative evidence/claim text. Not automatic proof.

independent_of_subject.description: DEPRECATED alias. Readers may map to independence_claimed; writers should use independence_claimed.

expires_at.description: Optional. If absent, endorsement does not expire.

algorithm.description: RFC 8032 Ed25519. HMAC is not a Rune endorsement identity mechanism.

value.description: Base64-encoded Ed25519 signature over UTF-8(JCS(payload excluding signature)).

jethro_color.description: Optional Jethro triage color at issuance.
